name: beads
description: Beads (bd) conventions for persistent task DAGs, atomic claims, native reply threads, decision records, ambiguity handling, actor identity, JSON envelopes, and Dolt sync. Steering separates local comments from cross-boundary decisions and harness wakes from persisted messages, and owns the carrier doctrine that dependent packages map onto. A build-formula skill covers formula authoring: conditional steps, gates, composition, and the assertions that prove a formula pours the DAG it declares. A guard denies mutating `gh issue` commands in Beads repositories. Opt-in sync hooks prefer native Dolt sync -- pull at session start, a detached push at session end once a `git push --dry-run` probe confirms it goes through, with a configurable pusher for hosts that need a wrapper -- and fall back to JSONL over ordinary git otherwise. The same session-start hook reports when Dolt history has grown enough to trim, and never trims it. Global `bd setup` wires session start; `bd init --skip-hooks` initializes repositories. Requires Beads >= 1.1.0 and python3 on PATH, and activates only in repositories with `.beads/`.
